title: Thomas Randolph to the Earl of Sussex, Edinburgh, 5 July 1570, BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 277 (DECODE R4931)

steps.what: Fetched R4931 and the linked key record R4930 with the shared cookie; R4931's images are copies of R4930's P3/P5, and R4930's other pages are Burghley's Norfolk notes, not a key.
Tomokiyo's Elizabethan cipher pages: no Randolph-Sussex key.
Boyd CSP Scotland iii on archive.org: no. 339 abstracts the letter (Edinburgh 5 July 1570) from Sussex's clear copy.
Token transcription of the five cipher runs from zoomed crops.
Aligned Boyd's abstract with word lengths: unto, course, and, to, conscien(ce), confidence, home cumming, souldiers may be continewed in pay.
Unconstrained homophonic anneal (en-1640s, word divisions): produced 'murderers and traitors', 'regent', 'whome ... conscience they thinke them selues ... unto'.
Anneal with crib words pinned to fill the ~25 open words: did not converge (merged sign classes).
Swept DECODE records of the same volume: R4932 (f. 278) is the contemporary decipherment of f. 277.
Transcribed the f. 278 glosses and checked them against the f. 277 cipher; all five runs read, three gloss words doubtful.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary decipherment on f. 278 (DECODE R4932) gives every cipher word; before it was found, a crib attack using Boyd's CSP Scotland iii no. 339 abstract had read about 70% of the words, and f. 278 confirmed all of them.
outcome.notes: About 70% read by crib attack before the contemporary decipherment (f. 278) was found; it agrees with every value recovered. DECODE date 1569 corrected to 5 July 1570; R4930 is not a key. Catalogue entry 99 removed.

prior.where: contemporary decipherment on f. 278 (DECODE R4932, status Decrypted); Boyd, Calendar of Scottish Papers iii (1903) no. 339 abstracts Sussex's clear copy

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
